description: Helper functions for PDF processing, including provider support check, page range parsing, text coercion, configuration coercion, and token limit resolution.

methods.name: providerSupportsNativePdf
methods.description: Checks if a provider supports native PDF input.

methods.name: parsePageRange
methods.description: Converts a page range string into an array of page numbers.

methods.name: coercePdfAssistantText
methods.description: Extracts and coerces assistant message text, throwing errors if invalid.

methods.name: coercePdfModelConfig
methods.description: Creates a PDF model configuration object from optional settings.

methods.name: resolvePdfToolMaxTokens
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of tokens for a PDF tool, respecting model limits.
